description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans ClientBuilder, focusing on client configuration, service registration, and startup behaviors, including scenarios with missing or invalid configurations.

classes.name: NoOpGatewaylistProvider
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of IGatewayListProvider for testing client configuration without real gateways.

classes.name: ClientBuilderTests
classes.description: Contains various tests validating the behavior of the Orleans ClientBuilder, including configuration validation, service registration, and error scenarios.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ClusterOptionsTest
methods.description: Tests that creating a client without required ClusterId and ServiceId throws OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_NoSpecifiedConfigurationTest
methods.description: Verifies that a client can be created with default configuration.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ThrowsDuringStartupIfNoGrainInterfacesAdded
methods.description: Ensures startup fails if no grain interfaces are registered.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ServiceProviderTest
methods.description: Checks that services registered through ConfigureServices are available and prioritize registration order.

methods.name: ClientBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfSiloBuildersAdded
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if both silo and client are configured in the same host.

methods.name: ClientBuilderWithHotApplicationBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfSiloBuildersAdded
methods.description: Verifies exception when both silo and client configurations are added via Host.CreateApplicationBuilder.
